trainer/30502.htm.text: Seer Umos: We are the children of fire, filled with the flame of life and strength and power. That is our history...and our destiny. You must make our ancestors proud with your words and deeds.

trainer/30502-noteach.htm.text: Seer Umos: I look into the will of great Pa'agrio and teach Orc magic, but there is nothing I can teach you.

Q00416_PathOfTheOrcShaman/30502-01.html.text: Seer Umos: To meet an Orc brother in such a foreign place as this, I am truly glad to see you. From Tataru's letter, I see you have received the language of flame from the Hestui Totem Spirit. You have passed the first step in becoming an Orc shaman. However, to become a true Orc Shaman, you need m…

Q00416_PathOfTheOrcShaman/30502-02.html.text: Seer Umos: As I already explained, you must prepare something before meeting the Duda-Mara Totem Spirit. Hunt the grizzly bear that lives in Gludio and bring back its blood. If you collect enough to fill three bottles, bring it back to me.

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
